title: Learning Nonlocal Interactions in Large-Scale Heterogeneous Metamaterials through Scientific Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41887v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In multiscale systems, nonlocal interactions among spatially distributed constituents can unlock collective, potentially emergent behavior irreducible to individual constituent responses. Beyond characterization, nonlocality in multiscale systems is increasingly viewed as a design element across fracture mechanics, wave physics, and disordered systems. Existing nonlocality theories provide rigorous descriptions and mechanistic insight, but often require prescribed analytic forms, range, symmetries, or periodicity. Machine learning offers a data-driven route to learn interactions, yet principled approaches that tie the network design to physical theory remain nascent. Here we present domain-decomposition attention neural operator (DANO), which learns configuration-dependent interactions in heterogeneous systems governed by linear field equations from field data alone. translated_title: 通过科学机器学习在大规模非均质超材料中学习非局域相互作用
translated_abstract: 在多尺度系统中，空间分布的组分之间的非局域相互作用可以释放出集体的、潜在的涌现行为，这种行为无法被简化为单个组分的响应。除了表征之外，多尺度系统中的非局域性在断裂力学、波物理学和无序系统中正日益被视为一种设计元素。现有的非局域性理论提供了严格的描述和机理洞察，但通常需要预先给定解析形式、作用范围、对称性或周期性。机器学习提供了一条数据驱动地学习相互作用的途径，然而将网络设计与物理理论相联系的原则性方法仍处于起步阶段。在此，我们提出了域分解注意力神经算子（DANO），它仅从场数据中学习由线性场方程控制的非均质系统中依赖构型的相互作用。通过在大规模光学超构表面上的案例研究，我们证明了……
tldr: 本文提出域分解注意力神经算子（DANO），仅从场数据出发学习大规模非均质超材料中由线性场方程控制的依赖构型的非局域相互作用，并在大规模光学超构表面案例中加以验证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the domain-decomposition attention neural operator (DANO), which learns configuration-dependent nonlocal interactions in large-scale heterogeneous metamaterials governed by linear field equations from field data alone, demonstrated through a case study on large-scale optical metasurfaces.
